title: eyeprocesspy: Vendor-neutral Python infrastructure for eye-tracking and multimodal process data
description: eyeprocesspy is the Python port of the frozen R eyeprocess 0.11.1 reference. Version 0.1.0 implements the full 1,182-function public API and provides vendor-neutral infrastructure for eye-tracking, pupillometry, biometrics, psychometrics, item-response theory, multimodal process data, validation evidence, reproducibility, plotting, storage, and controlled interoperability. Cross-language differences that cannot be byte-identical are explicitly gated and documented rather than silently substituted.
